supersedes: FROZEN.json (high-based drawdown, TR volatility ratio). Reason: Yahoo FX daily bars carry bad high/low prints (0.24% of bars have highs >3% above the open-close body), which make a high-based drawdown fire on phantom spikes. v2 uses closes only for every rule input.
selection_rule: Unchanged from FROZEN.json, applied to the dev split only: highest lift in P(further severe drop within H days) among configs firing on 0.3%-1.0% of instrument-days; ties within 0.2 lift -> simplest. Volatility-halt threshold: the round value closest to the dev frequency of the v1 rule (TR > 3.0x fired on 0.75% of dev FX days; close-based 4.5x fires on 0.80%).
disclosure: The v1 held-out years were scored once for the high-based rule, so they are not pristine for v2. v2 is therefore ALSO scored on instruments never downloaded before v2 was frozen (data/equity_fresh, data/fx_fresh).
rule_definition: Window = latest daily close and the 3 closes before it. drop = (max close in window - latest close) / max close in window. Fires when drop >= dmin AND latest close <= every earlier close in the window.

volatility_halt.definition: |ln(close_t / close_t-1)| / mean of the 20 prior |ln(close_i / close_i-1)|
volatility_halt.evaluation: P(max |close_t+k / close_t - 1| over k=1..5 >= 3%) on halt days vs all days; reported, not used for selection

crypto: not shipped: v1 crypto rule failed held-out (see FROZEN.json / heldout_results.json)
data_notes: Same loaders as v1: Yahoo daily split-adjusted equities (index ETFs excluded), Yahoo FX with every pair also scored inverted, USDCNY/USDARS/USDRUB excluded, single-bar spikes >8% reversing >6% removed.
